columns.name: (State & UT-wise) | Percemage Share in Total Suicides

To neutralize the effect of population increase, the rate of Suicides i.e., number of suicidal deaths per lakh of population is considered as a better measure. West Bengal which had the maximum share (13.9%) in total suicides reported in the country during 1994 ranked eighth highest (17.2) in as far as the rate of suicide is concerned. The All-India rate of suicide in the year 1994 is 9.9. As in the past, Kerala tops the list among states this year also with a rate of 28.0. The following table shows that rate of suicides is constantly increasing in the state over last few years. It is a matter of serious concern that the state with the highest literacy rate of 90.6 as against national average of 52.1 (as per 1991 census), is reporting a steady increase in this undesirable phenomenon. Kerala was followed by Karnataka (19.1).
